COLINSPATCHKIT-MAP.title: Map
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_CURRENT_NODE_TOOLTIP: Show the game-state tooltip when hovering the floor you're currently on. Vanilla only shows it for floors you've already visited.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_MAP_NODE_INFO_TOOLTI: Hovering an upcoming floor shows an informative tooltip about the floor — wiki-level info only, never the specific outcome. Hold Cmd/Ctrl to list the events, elites or enemies that could still spawn.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_POTION_CHANCES.title: Show potion chances
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_POTION_CHANCES.hover: Show your potion-drop chance in combat map tooltips — on past, current and upcoming floors.
COLINSPATCHKIT-COMBAT.title: Combat
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_WELL_LAID_PLANS_RETA: Show retain slots for Well Laid Plans
Show retain slots for Well Laid Plans
When retaining cards with Well Laid Plans, show one dotted card outline per card you can still retain.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SORT_CURSES_AND_STATUSES_: When choosing a draw-pile card to exhaust (Cleanse) or transform (Charge, Séance), list curses, statuses, and quest cards first instead of last — they're usually the ones you want gone.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_RELIC_READY_PULSES.t: Pulse relics while their effect is ready
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_RELIC_READY_PULSES.h: Pulse relics while their effect is ready
Pulse more relic icons while their limited effect is still available. Vanilla is missing this logic for many relics.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_POWER_READY_PULSES.t: Pulse buffs/debuffs while their effect is ready
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_POWER_READY_PULSES.h: Pulse buffs/debuffs while their effect is ready

Pulse a buff/debuff icon while its limited effect is still available: first-each-turn effects (e.g. Echo Form), counters one step from triggering (e.g. Juggling), countdowns firing after this turn (e.g. The Bomb), and end-of-turn damage debuffs as a block reminder (e.g. Constrict).
COLINSPATCHKIT-MENUS.title: Menus
COLINSPATCHKIT-EXCLUDE_CHARACTERS_FROM_R: With Random selected, right-click a character to ban it from the roll (right-click again to unban). Embarking as Random then picks only from those left. In multiplayer, only your own pick is affected.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_SHOP_AFFORDABILITY_P: Hovering a shop item turns other prices red if you can't afford both.
COLINSPATCHKIT-CONFIRM_REST_SITE_PROCEED: Hold to confirm leaving a rest site with Tent
Hold to confirm leaving a rest site with Tent

With Miniature Tent, the proceed button requires a hold to confirm while you still have an unused, selectable rest site option — so you don't accidentally leave your second action behind. A quick click does nothing; release early to cancel.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_CARD_REWARD_VIEW_UPG: Show View Upgrades toggle on card rewards
Show View Upgrades toggle on card rewards
Add the deck view's "View Upgrades" toggle to the card reward screen to preview reward cards upgraded. Also works with Scroll Boxes.
COLINSPATCHKIT-MATCH_COMPENDIUM_MULTIPLA: Match Compendium multiplayer cards to run
Match Compendium multiplayer cards to run
Default the Compendium's "Multiplayer cards" toggle to match your run — off in singleplayer, on in multiplayer — instead of always on.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SPEED_UPS.title: Speed-ups
COLINSPATCHKIT-SKIP_GAME_OVER_ANIMATIONS: On the run-summary screen, click to skip the one-line-at-a-time score reveal and resolve it instantly.
COLINSPATCHKIT-MOVE_SHOP_HAND_AWAY_FASTE: Return the merchant's pointing hand to rest faster after you stop hovering an item, so it stops blocking your view of the wares.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SKIP_RETURNED_CARD_PREVIE: Send returned reward cards straight to deck
Send returned reward cards straight to deck
Send special card rewards (Thieving Hopper, Lantern Key) straight to your deck instead of blocking the screen for two seconds.
COLINSPATCHKIT-CONSOLE.title: Console
COLINSPATCHKIT-ALLOW_MULTILINE_CONSOLE_I: Let the dev console hold multiple lines: press Shift+Enter for a new line, or paste a block of commands. Enter runs every line in order, stopping at the first one that fails. Takes effect on the next launch.
